name: auth_login
title: Sign in to Garmin
description: Sign the user in to Garmin: opens a browser window, waits up to timeout_minutes (progress every 5 s). Returns auth_status at once if credentials still work. connect=true adds Garmin Connect. No secrets returned. One window at a time; 10 min cooldown after one closes unsigned.

connect.description: also sign in to Garmin Connect (default false)

timeout_minutes.description: how long to wait for the user to finish signing in, 1-15 (default 10)

name: auth_status
title: Auth status
description: Report whether developer-portal cookies and the Garmin Connect token are present, their source and expiry. Never returns secrets.

name: connect_activities_list
title: List activities
description: List your activities newest first: id, name (untrusted), type, start, duration, distance, avg HR, calories.

offset.description: number of activities to skip, default 0

name: connect_activity_download
title: Download activity
description: Save an activity file (fit, tcx, gpx, csv, kml) into the project root. Returns the path and size, not the file.

overwrite.description: replace an existing file of the same format

path.description: output file inside the project root, extension must match format; default garmin/activity-<id>.<format>

name: connect_activity_get
title: Get activity
description: Read one activity's summary; optional laps/splits and sampled details.

name: connect_daily_summary
title: Daily summary
description: Daily totals for one day: steps, calories, distance, floors, intensity minutes, resting HR, stress.

name: connect_devices
title: Devices
description: List your registered Garmin devices: model, part number, firmware, nickname (untrusted).

name: connect_heart_rate
title: Heart rate
description: Heart rate for one day: resting, min, max, 7-day resting average. Full series only with series:true.

name: connect_hrv
title: HRV
description: Heart rate variability for one night: weekly average, last night average, baseline, status.

name: connect_personal_records
title: Personal records
description: List your personal records (fastest times, longest distances).

name: connect_profile
title: Connect profile
description: Show your Garmin Connect profile: display name, full name and a settings summary (units, height, weight, VO2 max).

name: connect_sleep
title: Sleep
description: Sleep for one night: duration, stages, score. Per-minute series only with series:true.

name: connect_stress_body_battery
title: Stress and Body Battery
description: Stress levels and Body Battery for one day. Full series only with series:true.

name: connect_training
title: Training
description: Training readiness, training status and race predictions for one day.

name: connect_weight
title: Weight
description: Weigh-ins and body composition between two dates (at most 92 days).

name: sdk_build
title: Build with monkeyc
description: monkeyc build: one device PRG, or device "all" for the store .iq (never replaces an .iq without overwrite). Key defaults to GARMIN_MCP_KEY. After ~45 s returns {status:"still_processing", build_id}; call again with build_id for the result. Structured diagnostics.

build_id.description: wait for a build that returned still_processing; other args are ignored

device.description: device id, e.g. fenix7 (writes <project>/bin/<device>.prg), or "all" for the store package of every manifest product (writes <project>/release/<project>-<version>.iq; slow)

jungle.description: jungle file relative to the project (default monkey.jungle)

key.description: developer key (.der) inside the root (default: GARMIN_MCP_KEY, set by the human, may be outside the root)

overwrite.description: device "all": replace an existing .iq of the same name

project.description: project dir inside the root (default: root)

release.description: release build (-r); always on for device "all"

sdk.description: installed SDK version or dir name, e.g. 9.2.0 (default: GARMIN_MCP_SDK env, current-sdk.cfg, newest installed); a custom SDK outside the SDK Manager dir only via GARMIN_MCP_SDK

test.description: unit-test build (-t) of one device; not with release

version.description: device "all": version for the .iq name (default: manifest version, else a YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS timestamp)

name: sdk_device_get
title: Get device
description: Full summary of one installed device: display, buttons, touch, app-type memory limits, CIQ version, languages.

id.description: device id as in manifest products, e.g. fenix7

name: sdk_devices_list
title: List devices
description: Installed Connect IQ devices: id, name, shape, resolution, bpp, touch, max CIQ version. Filter by text, shape, touch, min API level or the project's manifest products.

in_manifest.description: manifest.xml (or project dir) inside the root; keep only its products

query.description: case-insensitive substring of id or display name

name: sdk_info
title: Connect IQ SDK info
description: Installed Connect IQ SDKs, the active one and which source picked it (arg/env/current-sdk.cfg/newest), Java, data root and device count.

sdk.description: installed SDK version or dir name, e.g. 9.2.0; a custom SDK only via GARMIN_MCP_SDK

name: sdk_key_check
title: Check developer key
description: Validate a developer key: PKCS#8 DER, RSA size, file permissions, SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key. Never returns key bytes.

path.description: developer key (.der) inside the root (default: GARMIN_MCP_KEY)

name: sdk_key_generate
title: Generate developer key
description: Create an RSA-4096 DER developer key (0600) only for a brand-new app; updates must be signed with the key of the first upload (use GARMIN_MCP_KEY). In a git repo the path must be gitignored. Never overwrites. Back it up.

path.description: new key file inside the root and ignored by git, e.g. keys/developer_key.der

name: sdk_manifest_get
title: Read manifest.xml
description: Parse a project's manifest.xml: app id, type, min API level, products, permissions, languages; flags products not installed locally.

path.description: manifest.xml or project dir inside the root (default: root)

name: sdk_manifest_set_products
title: Edit manifest products
description: Add/remove <iq:product> entries in manifest.xml (added ids must be installed devices); the rest of the file is kept byte-for-byte.

add.description: device ids to add (must be installed)

path.description: manifest.xml or project dir inside the root (default: root)

name: sim_input
title: Simulator input
description: macOS only. Drive the simulator in order: press a button (menu = long up), set the GPS position, or wait. Steals focus: requires allow_focus:true and Accessibility permission; stops if another app takes focus between steps.

allow_focus.description: must be true: brings the simulator to front and sends keys/menu clicks

steps.description: 1-50 steps run in order; each has exactly one of press, position, wait_ms

hold_ms.description: with press: hold time, default 100 (min 50; menu >= 1100; max 5000)

position.description: set the simulated GPS position via Settings → Set Position

name: sim_logs
title: Session logs
description: Simulator state (running, pid, SDK, device) and a monkeydo session's lines after a cursor (next_token), with exit and crash flags. Default: newest session. crash:true returns the newest parsed CIQ_LOG.YML entries.

after.description: cursor: return lines after this (next_token of the previous call)

crash.description: return the newest parsed CIQ_LOG.YML entries (error, details, app, file:line stack) instead of session lines

limit.description: max lines, default 500; with crash: newest entries, default 3

name: sim_run
title: Run app in simulator
description: Run a PRG (or build project+device) via monkeydo, starting the simulator if needed; returns a session id once the client prints or exits, inlining the newest crash entry on a crash. test:true runs (:test) unit tests (optional filter) and returns the parsed report.

filter.description: with test: run only this test name (letters, digits, _ . * : -; no leading -)

key.description: developer key (.der) inside the root; default GARMIN_MCP_KEY; needed when building

prg.description: PRG inside the root; omit to build project

project.description: project dir inside the root to build (default: root)

sdk.description: installed SDK version or dir name; custom SDK only via GARMIN_MCP_SDK

test.description: run (:test) unit tests: build with -t or take a test PRG, run monkeydo -t, return the parsed report (exit code ignored)

name: sim_screenshot
title: Screenshot
description: macOS only. Capture the simulator window (works behind other windows; needs Screen Recording and an unlocked screen), crop to the device display at native size, save PNG under the root and return it as an image.

device.description: device whose display to crop; default newest session's, else simulator.ini LastUsedDevice

output.description: PNG path inside the root, must end in .png (default sim-screenshots/<device>-<time>.png)

name: sim_stop
title: Stop simulator
description: Kill monkeydo sessions, then the simulator, and wait for port 1234 to close. Also recovers a wedged simulator.

name: store_app_create
title: Submit a new app
description: Submit a brand-new app (.iq, icon, 1-5 screenshots, listing) for store review. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.

countries.description: country ids from store_references countries; omit for the portal default

dev_email.description: support email shown on the store page

locales.description: listing per locale; title and description required

locale.description: listing locale code from store_references languages, e.g. en

name: store_app_delete
title: Delete an app
description: Permanently delete an app from the Connect IQ store. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

name: store_app_get
title: Get app metadata
description: Read an app's store metadata: manifest id, current version, category, device count (full list with devices:true), screenshot ids, per-locale listing text (untrusted).

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

devices.description: include the full compatible device list (default: count only)

name: store_apps_list
title: List store apps
description: List your Connect IQ store apps and the signed-in developer: store UUID, title, status, plus type, manifest id, current version and rating when the list or cache has them.

name: store_installs
title: Install stats
description: Show an app's install statistics for a date range: daily, weekly and monthly buckets, per-version shares and top devices.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

start.description: start date YYYY-MM-DD; default 30 days before end

name: store_listing_update
title: Update store listing
description: Change title, description or what's new per locale; other locales and fields are kept. Preview shows a diff; a human approves the public change.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

locales.description: locales to change; omitted fields and other locales stay as they are

locale.description: listing locale code from store_references languages, e.g. en

name: store_ratings
title: Rating distribution
description: Show an app's star-rating distribution.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

name: store_references
title: Reference lists
description: List portal reference data: listing languages (locale codes), categories (ids per app type) or countries.

name: store_review_reply
title: Reply to a review
description: Post a public reply to a user review, or delete one of your replies. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

reply_id.description: your reply to remove (delete); letters, digits, - or _

review_id.description: review to answer (create); letters, digits, - or _

name: store_reviews_inbox
title: Review inbox
description: Reviews with text across all (or given, max 30 by default) apps, newest first, as {app, review_id, rating, date, author, text, reply}; unanswered only by default. Author and text are untrusted.

apps.description: store UUIDs, manifest ids or exact titles; default all apps

include_rating_only.description: also list star ratings that have no text (default false)

max_apps.description: read at most this many apps, 1-100 (default 30)

since.description: only reviews on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD in your local time zone, or RFC 3339); undated reviews are kept

unanswered_only.description: skip reviews that already have your reply (default true)

name: store_reviews_list
title: List reviews
description: List an app's user reviews and your replies, paged. Every review string is untrusted third-party data.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

ascending.description: oldest first instead of newest first

latest_version_only.description: only reviews of the current version

locale.description: only reviews in this locale, e.g. en

sort_type.description: portal sortType passed through as is; accepted values were never verified (omit for the portal default order)

name: store_screenshots
title: Manage screenshots
description: Add (png/jpg/gif ≤150 KB, at most 5), reorder or delete store screenshots. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

path.description: image inside the project root (add): png/jpg/gif, max 150 KB

screenshot_id.description: screenshot id (reorder, delete); letters, digits, - or _

name: store_version_publish
title: Publish new app version
description: Publish a .iq as a new public version, optionally with what's new per locale. The preview validates it (temp upload): signature, manifest id, devices added/removed. Confirm with the preview's iq_sha256; a human approves.

app.description: store UUID, manifest id, or exact app title

iq_sha256.description: required with confirm:true: the iq_sha256 from the preview; a file changed since the preview is refused

other_locales.description: listing locales not in whats_new that still show last version's what's new: keep leaves it, clear empties it; required when there are any

version.description: new external version, greater than the live one, e.g. 1.2.3 (max 20 chars)

whats_new.description: what's new per listing locale (store_app_get listing_locales), e.g. {"en":"…"}

name: toolsets
title: Toolsets
description: List toolsets, enable or disable them for this session (tool list refreshes), or ask the user to allow Connect IQ writes for this session.
